description: Saves this conversation's plan in Mannie, where the owner can read, edit and run it. A conversation holds one plan, so saving again replaces it. Nothing runs until the owner starts it. Write it for someone who has not read this conversation.
name: save_plan

activity.description: A few words for the owner that say what this call does, as an ongoing action, such as "Reading package.json" or "Counting the failed tests".

body.description: The whole plan in Markdown, at most 32 KiB.

title.description: A few words that name the plan, at most 80 characters.
